description: Send an email. `agent` is OPTIONAL: without it the workspace's single agent is used, or one is created (named from `from`) when this connection may create agents (Full access, or a key with `manage`), so a first send needs no setup; with several agents, `agent` says which one sends. The reputation firewall runs on every send: an agent auto-suspended for crossing a 0.3% complaint rate is blocked (422 agent_paused), a send with a suppressed address in to, cc or bcc is refused whole (422 recipient_suppressed), and the response returns the classifier_score, which shows how the send was graded.

agent.description: Optional. The agent to send as; without it the workspace's default is used, or created when this connection may create agents. When it is given it decides the sender: a `from` beside it picks no agent and creates none.

attachments.description: Up to 10 files, 25 MB in all. Each has a filename and either content_base64 (with content_type) or path, an https URL mails.ai downloads when it sends (content_type optional). Files given as content_base64 travel inside the request, so together they can come to about 3 MB: give a larger one by path. A file with content_id is shown inside body_html where it says cid:<content_id>, instead of being attached. Not with a future scheduled_at: a scheduled send cannot carry attachments yet (400).

content_base64.description: The file's bytes, base64. Give this or path, not both.

content_id.description: Show the file inside the HTML: shows the file whose content_id is "logo".

content_type.description: MIME type. Required with content_base64; with path, the type the URL answers with is used.

path.description: An https URL fetched at send time: it must answer within 10 seconds, after at most 3 redirects, at a public address. A file that cannot be fetched refuses the send (400 invalid_field, param attachments.N.path).

from.description: Optional. The sender you want, as a handle or address — "billing", "billing@acme.com" and "Acme <billing@acme.com>" all mean the agent called "billing". It SELECTS that agent: resolved if it exists. If it does not, it is created when this connection may create agents (Full access, or a key with `manage`) and the plan has room; otherwise the send is refused, with 403 insufficient_scope or, when the plan has no room, 402 plan_limit_exceeded. It is never resolved to a DIFFERENT agent, and it cannot spoof a sender. Beside an explicit `agent` it selects nothing: `agent` decides the sender. Either way a display name in it, like Acme above, goes on the From line, a scheduled send's too. The address that actually sent comes back as `from` on the result.

idempotency_key.description: Any string up to 255 characters: a call repeated with the same key returns the first answer instead of sending twice. Without it, the call gets a key of its own.

list_unsubscribe.description: Adds RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe headers (List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post), for newsletters, digests and other recurring mail. One click suppresses the address for the whole workspace. The message needs exactly one recipient: one `to`, and no cc or bcc.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 future timestamp. A future time cannot be combined with attachments.

name: mails_send
title: Send an email
